b90f0f90542fe371.name: O'Grady Peyton International (USA)
b90f0f90542fe371.description: Recruits and places international nurses and allied healthcare professionals in U.S. jobs and supports licensing, visas, relocation, and immigration processes.
b90f0f90542fe371.identity_evidence: AMN Healthcare SEC exhibit from 2023 explicitly names O Grady-Peyton International (USA), Inc. as holder of the O Grady Peyton and O Grady Peyton International trademarks. Historical legal-name evidence and current affiliation support identity; parent and overseas subsidiaries are not merged.

ffb1eb96dc382769.description: National chamber organization supporting AAPI and other small-business owners through advocacy, grants, and entrepreneurship programs.
ffb1eb96dc382769.identity_evidence: Official National ACE 2022 Seattle roundtable release expands National Asian/Pacific Islander American Chamber of Commerce and Entrepreneurship. Tax status of the separate International Leadership Foundation mentioned in the release is not transferred to National ACE; ACE Foundation remains separate.
